6.338 rsPostSortAggregateInAggregateExpression
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsPostSortAggregateInAggregateExpression is a critical error that will occur when an aggregate
function references a First, Last, or Previous aggregate function in its Expression parameter.
